description.value: Earls Station Square is a full-service Kitchen + Bar situated in Burnaby's Station Square development, part of a well-established Canadian casual-dining chain with locations across BC and North America. The restaurant offers both indoor seating and an outdoor patio, a broad American-style menu with vegan and vegetarian options, and accepts cash as well as cards. It sits within a large mixed-use complex and is a comfortable sit-down stop for cyclists passing through the Metrotown corridor.
